messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: GPU hotpool 'hotpath-usw2' reported sustained saturation >95% and autoscaler heartbeats delayed (120s). Tokenbucket 429 spike observed across tiered routes. Paging oncall.
Alex (oncall): On it. seeing 429 graph spike and queue growth. any immediate customer impact? :eyes:
Jen (sre): Customers on dedicated pools unaffected, but hosted routed traffic hitting hotpath is returning a lot of 429s and some retries causing queue amplification. Latency tail rising to 6s for short requests.
Priya (eng-runtime): Logs show scaler: "last_heartbeat=125s, requeue_count=3, scale_attempts=0" — scaler stuck trying to acquire lease on pool manager. possible etcd lock contention.
Sam (eng-platform): Confirmed. Autoscaler leader election timed out multiple times. We pushed the recent leader-election change last week. reverting now.
Alex (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily relax tokenbucket refill on tier=hosted-hotpath 2) open fallback routing to 'hotpath-standby' 3) force-restart autoscaler leader process 4) communicate to support. executing 1 and 2 now.
Priya (eng-runtime): Patch to increase token refill rate:

```
# PATCH: increase refill for hosted-hotpath
route_policy:
  hosted-hotpath:
    token_bucket:
      refill_per_sec: 12000  # bumped from 3000
      burst: 60000
```

Applying via config service.
Sam (eng-platform): flip route to standby pool (hotpath-standby) for 30% of traffic:

```
redwoodctl route update --name=hotpath --split=standby=30,hotpath=70
```

Applied. monitoring for 429s.
OpsBot: Auto-scaler restart scheduled: restarting redwood-autoscaler on hotpath-manager-1..3. Rolling restarts starting.
Jen (sre): Noted a root cause lead: the last release changed the lease TTL to 10s in leader-election, which isn't enough under heavy etcd GC. I’ll revert the TTL to 60s.
Alex (oncall): Observing immediate 429 drop where traffic routed to standby. Overall 429s down ~40% but hotpath queue still growing for pinned customers.
Maria (support): Heads-up — we have two customer dashboards showing elevated errors (acct: acme-inc, beta-app). Drafting outbound note. => "We're seeing elevated errors for some requests; mitigation in progress and we'll post an update in 30m." Should we offer a temporary capacity reservation?
Priya (eng-runtime): Also seeing repeated long-running token-window requests from some clients — marking them to throttled mode to clear queue:

```
# temporarily downgrade long-run requests
routing.rules:
  - match: {client_tags: long_stream}
    action: downgrade_model: rwd-medium
    rate_limit: 5r/s
```

Applying now.
Jen (sre): Leader TTL reverted and autoscaler leader elected. restart completed on manager-1..3. Scale attempts resumed; additional 4 replicas requested. Watch for backfill.
Alex (oncall): After replicas added, queue length dropped ~60%, latency returning toward baseline. Still seeing occasional 429 bursts when multiple clients retry. Will keep token refill higher for 15min then step down.
Sam (eng-platform): Note: the tier policy had mismatch on route-tag evaluation which caused some high-priority tokens to be consumed by background jobs. Fixing boolean match logic in policy eval.
Priya (eng-runtime): Committed a small hotfix to policy evaluator; deploying to canary now. It prevents background jobs from matching hosted-hotpath priority.
Maria (support): Customer note ready. Sending now and adding status page entry: "We are mitigating a routing/scaling issue causing intermittent 429s for hosted inference; service partially degraded. Next update in 30 min." :email:
Alex (oncall): Post-mitigation checklist: 1) keep refill at higher level for 15 min 2) monitor backpressure and 429s 3) revert policy TTL change in next deploy with test for etcd latencies 4) run post-incident blameless RCA today.
Jen (sre): Captured logs/snippets to incident log. Root causes so far: leader-election TTL too low + rate-policy boolean mismatch + tokenbucket conservative refill. ACTIONS: revert release, add e2e for leader election, tighten policy tests, add tokenbucket autosuggest to console.
OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: hotpath healthy. traffic normalized. 429s reduced to baseline. auto-scaler stable. Incident will be transitioned to 'investigating' and assigned to eng-runtime for RCA.
Alex (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving follow-up tasks for postmortem. Will ping again if we see new spikes. :thumbsup:
